description: This file defines a DAO interface for products in a sales and inventory management system using Room database. It includes methods for listing products and inserting multiple products with conflict handling.

classes.name: ProductDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for product-related database operations, including querying and inserting product data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a flow of product entities ordered by their ID in descending order.

methods.name: insertAll
methods.description: Inserts a list of product entities into the database, replacing existing entries on conflict.
